info.name: Slot16 PE Hotel - Room Reservation Gateway

exec: pm.test('Room list is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('Room is created with AVAILABLE status', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); pm.collectionVariables.set('roomId', body.data.roomId); });
pm.test('Duplicate uses HTTP 226 and business status 3', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(226); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql(3); });

pm.test('Only the supplied room field changes', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.pricePerNight).to.eql(750000); });

pm.test('Room filters and pagination work', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.content).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Reservation is confirmed and total is calculated', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); pm.expect(body.data.totalAmount).to.eql(2250000); pm.collectionVariables.set('reservationId', body.data.reservationId); });

pm.test('ReservationDetailDTO embeds RoomDTO', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.room.roomId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId'))); });

pm.test('Reservation amount is recalculated', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.totalAmount).to.eql(3000000); });

pm.test('Reservation filters and details work', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data.content).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Reservation is cancelled without deleting it', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Room is moved to maintenance', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql(1); });
